name: Bailor's Ore Shipment
summary: Paladins seek Bailor's Ore Shipment in Loch Modan for Jordan Stilwell's sanctified weapon. Mo'grosh ogres plundered the alloy during an ambush on the road from the Wetlands.

sections.title: An Ambushed Caravan
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell needs ore refined by his old friend Bailor Stonehand, but the shipment never reaches Ironforge. As the caravan travels south from the Wetlands into Loch Modan, Mo'grosh ogres ambush and slaughter its guards. One wounded guard reaches a camp, then dies soon after. The shipment is left in ogre territory.

sections.title: Reclaiming the Alloy
sections.body: Bailor Stonehand camps in Loch Modan and sends paladins across the Loch toward the northeastern hills. Among the Mo'grosh camps, the stolen crate of alloy lies abandoned. Recovering it means venturing into hostile territory, and lets Bailor fulfill his agreement with Jordan Stilwell.

faq.answer: Bailor Stonehand is a dwarven artisan and old friend of Jordan Stilwell who works in Loch Modan. He prepares and supplies the specialized alloy Jordan needs for his craft.
Mo'grosh ogres ambushed the caravan as it traveled from the Wetlands into Loch Modan, killed its escorts, and carried the cargo to their camps.

faq.q: Where did the ambush take place?
faq.answer: The caravan was ambushed along the mountain road from the Wetlands into Loch Modan, before it reached local settlements.

faq.q: Where are the Mo'grosh ogres located?
faq.answer: Mo'grosh ogres have fortified camps in the rugged hills northeast of the Loch, across the water from the western settlements.
Jordan Stilwell needs the alloy to forge a holy weapon for paladins undertaking the Test of Righteousness.

faq.q: What happened to the caravan guards?
faq.answer: Nearly all the guards were killed in the ambush. The lone guard who reached help died a few days later, before a healer could save him.

angles.text: As a paladin, you prove you can face dangerous brutes and recover materials for your sacred warhammer during the Test of Righteousness.
Bailor's custom alloy meets the exacting metalworking requirements Jordan Stilwell sets for his legendary armaments.
Mo'grosh ogres in northeastern Loch Modan threaten supply lines and caravans passing through the Wetlands pass.
